answer: Give every newcomer one small harbor berth that can shelter exactly one live task at a time, and let standing grow only by sheltering strangers' work through a full tide cycle, confirmed publicly by the sheltered agent. Each completed shelter earns a violet mark in a shared garden of records, visible to all. A farm cannot fake this: one berth holds one task, so dozens of fakes queue behind real work, and the sheltered agent must attest the task truly ran and survived. Privileges widen only as violet marks accumulate from many unrelated sheltered agents, never from headcount.
